notes.drugprot_identifier_missing: DrugProt entity rows have mention identifiers, character offsets, and mention text. They do not have concept_id or raw_identifier fields, so identifier_missing equals the mention count.
notes.drugprot_concept_count: n_concepts_by_split collapses empty concept identifiers to one value per document and is not a normalised concept count.
notes.generation_completion: A generation shard is artefact_complete only when the number of adopted attempt lines is at least the frozen request count.
